Statistics practice books in **R, JASP and SPSS**, made for students at several universities — and for one-to-one help. Step by step, with animals that behave badly and statistics that slowly becomes clear.

[Inferential Statistics](inferential-statistics/index.html), the first card below, is in English. All the other books you can open here are in Dutch, and their titles say so. [The Dutch shelf](../../oefenboeken/index.html){hreflang="nl"} has the same books, and says more about each one.

## Taking a course?

Practice books that each go with one course, ordered by the university and the programme that teach it.

### [Inferential Statistics →](inferential-statistics/index.html){hreflang="en"} [R]{.cc-chip}
The English edition of the book below. A first-year course, called *Toetsende Statistiek* in the Dutch-taught programme. One page for each week of the course: first by hand, then R as a check, and every week ends with exam questions.
:::

::: {.cc-boek .cc-boek-vak}

### [Inferential Statistics (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/ts/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [R]{.cc-chip}
A first-year course, called *Toetsende Statistiek* in the Dutch-taught programme. One page for each week of the course: first by hand, then R as a check, and every week ends with exam questions.
:::

::: {.cc-boek .cc-boek-vak}
### [Psychometrics (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/psychometrie/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [R]{.cc-chip}
A second-year course: working R code with its output, next to the course's own R practicals.
:::

::: {.cc-boek .cc-boek-vak}

## With the book

<!-- BEN: (boek_overzicht_en, 28-11-2026) de boektitel wijst sinds vandaag naar het Engelse
     boekoverzicht (../book/index.qmd), zoals de Nederlandse plank naar manuscript/index.html; tot

Three practice books that go with [*The Regressive Backbone*](../book/index.qmd), chapter by chapter: the same topics in the same order, each in a different tool.

::: {.cc-plank}

::: {.cc-boek}
### [The R practice book (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/broertjes/r/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [R]{.cc-chip}
The book's own practice book in **R**: you run the code yourself, the shuffling simulations included.
:::

::: {.cc-boek}
### [The JASP practice book (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/broertjes/jasp/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [JASP]{.cc-chip}
The same material in **JASP**: click paths instead of code, with the shuffling toys in your browser.
:::

::: {.cc-boek}
### [The SPSS practice book (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/broertjes/spss/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [SPSS]{.cc-chip}
The same material in **SPSS**, through the *Analyze* menus.
:::

:::

### [The JASP handbook (in Dutch) →](../../manuscript/handleiding/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [JASP]{.cc-chip}
*Handleiding Statistiek met JASP*, the handbook that was there before the book, in which the techniques are tried out on the same small troop of monkeys. It belongs to no single course, so you can use it alongside any.
:::

:::
